timing.timestampEvidence: Creation/write times are filesystem metadata; exact authoring-start and first-inspection times were not recorded. Pre-inspection independence is the original isolated author attestation, not a fabricated timestamp.

freeze.hashScope: Exact original UTF-8 file bytes, including whitespace and final newline
freeze.rowProjectionAlgorithm: Select rows in original array order; JSON.stringify-equivalent compact JSON retaining object key order and literal Unicode; UTF-8; no final newline. This is not RFC 8785 canonicalization.

protocol.beforeAuthoring: No engine, risk, retrieval or existing fixture inspection by this case author. Cases authored in a separate context, not translated from the other authors.
protocol.afterFreeze: Development cases may be reviewed and scored; held-out outcomes remain aggregate-only and are reserved for the final frozen candidate.
protocol.labels: Observable wording expectations; neither confirmed criminal conduct nor verified safety.
protocol.updatePolicy: Frozen payload bytes remain unchanged. Corrections require a separate version with a new hash and preserved baseline.

independentReview.reviewScope: Attention-disagreement audit, partition/leakage checks and aggregate held-out scoring. Not native-speaker or real-world fraud validation.

metadataStorage: Detached sidecar preserves existing array readers and exact frozen file hashes; metadata was added after the original evaluation, not backdated.
